title: Walk SE under the DESIGN LOCK: lean deterministic pipeline (milestone 1)
question: Can one lean pipeline (rig copy, 10 springs, 14-colour 2-tone palette, vector outline, overlap-only interior lines, eyes+brows stamps) produce walk SE that passes every lock gate, and how far is it from the gold frames?
method: pipe/build_walk_se.sh (~35 s, deterministic). Rig r13 copy with narrower sleeves, a waist step at the obi, a flat-skin face and a solid bow. Walk re-baked through M's mbuild with 10 simulated spring bones. 8x guide/part/normal/depth passes. lock_chain.py: N.L 2-tone ramps on the 14 lock keys, a vector-line outline with part-wise temporal vertex hysteresis and dezig/polish, far-side K only at the listed overlaps, facesys b' eyes at the tracked surface point. Gates: lamet line, palette, P's limb audit, M's posture gate, gifcheck.
result: All blocking gates PASS. Per frame: zigzags 0, L-corners <= 1, gaps 0, 2x2 clumps 0, stray interior K 0, 11-12 colours, 0 off-lock or cross-material px, limb audit 0 failing frames, posture PASS, GIF loop with 70-120 ms frames. Report only: boil .0275, shade_swap .0107. Against round 10: zigzags 6.6 -> 0, L-corners 7.1 -> 0.1, mono .44 -> .79, interior K 42 -> 11, colours 16.1 -> 11.6. Gold f00/f02: sil IoU .63/.56, ssim .19/.20, 1761/1850 px differ; about half are silhouette.
verdict: Clean and on-lock, but not yet the gold. The gold differences are structural (near-frontal 3/4 turn, a wider head with a neck, the kimono collar and obi, leg/boot proportions), not sparse override pixels. Next round: a stronger SE body yaw cheat and head/kimono shape changes, then re-diff against the gold.
